premises.text: Meetings waste enormous time because agendas are missing and notes, photos, summaries, and follow-ups are scattered across calendar, photo library, notebook, and email
premises.evidence_span: Dave's meeting details and content are scattered everywhere

premises.text: Retrace is a mobile app that puts notes, photos, follow-up tasks, and contacts in meeting context with calendar sync, collaboration, post-meeting reminders, and prep for follow-ups
premises.evidence_span: It's a mobile app that puts your notes, photos, follow-up tasks, and contact information in the context of a meeting

premises.text: Go-to-market is bottom-up individual adoption like Dropbox/Yammer, then premium team integrations with cloud storage, CRMs, and task systems once adoption thresholds are hit
premises.evidence_span: bring value to the individual and drive adoption from the bottom up

value.text: People become more productive by remembering and organizing everything about their meetings in one place
value.evidence_span: helping you become a more productive person

causal_links.evidence_span: Meetings are a waste of time
Now you go to one place to remember everything
collaborate and share data about their meetings and contacts while still delivering tremendous amounts of value and control to the end user

notes: Agenda-less waste stats and scattered-artifacts pains folded as one meeting-organization problem (§4.1.6). Trace/retrace/succeed demo steps, GPS, social contact enrichment, collaborative notes/photos/tasks, and post-meeting reminders folded as app cascade (§4.1.7). Premium integrations kept with bottom-up GTM as one commercial path. Three domains are problem, product, and GTM—not a need/product/money triad.
